newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Itron estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Itron estimates cut.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said its analyst Joseph Arsenio trimmed his 1996 earnings estimate for Itron Inc to a loss of $0.08 a share from a loss of $0.06 a share.
-- Arsenio cut his 1997 estimates to a profit of $0.50 a share on revenues of $221 million from a previous $0.70 a share on revenues of $225 million.
-- In written research, Arsenio said company announcements in September imply lower gross margins and higher debt levels than expected. He maintains a hold on the stock.
-- He added, however, recent contracts from, and product delivieries to, AMR Corp may stimulate new orders.
-- Shares were trading down 3/8 at 19-5/8 in midmorning exchange trading.
